cards.claim: Simon Enqvist represents the Wyoming Cowboys.
cards.quote: And not just any basketball, but the fast-paced, rugged style of the Wyoming Cowboys. Simon's teammates, a motley crew of ranchers' sons and small-town heroes, eyed him warily at first. What could a soccer player from Finland possibly know about the rough-and-tumble world of Mountain West Conference hoops? But Simon's quiet confidence and work ethic soon won them over. He spent hours in the gym, honing his jump shot and perfecting his pick-and-roll game. As he took the court for the Cowboys' evening practice, Simon's eyes locked onto the towering figure of Coach Shyatt, a grizzled veteran of the college coaching ranks.
